headline: RBI extends Directions on Suri Friends' Union Co-op Bank till January 22, 2027
summary_points: RBI extends the Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the BR Act, 1949 for The Suri Friends' Union Co-operative Bank Ltd., Suri, West Bengal.
Extension is for three months, from close of business on October 22, 2026 to close of business on January 22, 2027, subject to review.
The Directions were first issued on July 21, 2022 and last extended up to October 22, 2026 by Directive dated July 14, 2026.
RBI states the extension does not imply satisfaction with the bank's financial position; all other terms remain unchanged.
who_is_affected: Depositors, members, creditors and officers of The Suri Friends' Union Co-operative Bank Ltd., and professionals advising them.
action_required: Continue to follow the existing Directions and restrictions applicable to the bank, and check the RBI website for the full Directive and any review.

social.linkedin:
RBI has extended the Directions issued to The Suri Friends' Union Co-operative Bank Ltd., Suri, West Bengal, under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.

Key points:
- The Directions, first issued on July 21, 2022, were last extended up to close of business on October 22, 2026.
- They are now extended for a further three months, up to close of business on January 22, 2027, subject to review.
- RBI has clarified that the extension should not be read as satisfaction with the bank's financial position.
- All other terms and conditions of the Directive remain unchanged.

For depositors, auditors and advisers connected with the bank, the existing restrictions continue to apply until the new date unless modified earlier.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1367) before acting.
